info.name: Daway Backend API
info.description:
QA/Test collection organized by feature. Every request maps to a route verified via `php artisan route:list` - no invented endpoints.

Execution order: 01 Auth (OTP verify saves patient_token, pharmacy login saves pharmacy_token) -> 09 Health/Public -> 03 Pharmacies -> 02 Patient features -> 04 Pharmacy Inventory -> 05 Price Comparison -> 06 Assistant -> 07 Accounting -> 08 Admin.

Destructive requests (DELETE, cancel) are manual-only: no scripts chain them automatically.

OTP/Auth code was not changed - only documented here for patient_token setup.

item.name: Register (pharmacy)

request.description: Dummy password only - replace with a test password before sending.
Same phone twice -> 422 phone already used.

item.description: Actual route: POST /api/register/pharmacy. Creates an INACTIVE pharmacy pending admin approval.

item.name: OTP
OTP - Verify - Existing user login (saves patient_token)

request.description: Registered phone + valid OTP -> 200 + data.token. Paste the code from Send response into {{patient_otp}}.

item.name: OTP - Register - Success (new patient via OTP verify)

request.description: THERE IS NO SEPARATE PATIENT REGISTER ROUTE: POST /api/otp/verify creates the patient on first verify. Flow: 1) Send OTP to a NEW phone, 2) run this with the fresh code + name/birth_date/latitude/longitude -> 200 data.token (user.is_new=true), token auto-saved to patient_token.
New phone + fresh OTP without name -> 422 errors.name + registration_required. Stale OTP -> 400 instead.
New phone + fresh OTP without birth_date -> 422 errors.birth_date + registration_required. Stale OTP -> 400 instead.
New phone + fresh OTP without latitude -> 422 errors.latitude + registration_required. Stale OTP -> 400 instead.
New phone + fresh OTP without longitude -> 422 errors.longitude + registration_required. Stale OTP -> 400 instead.
Missing phone -> 400 (existing-phone path) or 422 registration_required (new-phone path).

item.description: Actual routes: POST /api/otp/send, POST /api/otp/verify. NO standalone patient-register route: verify with a new phone + name/birth_date/latitude/longitude IS the registration. Wrong/expired OTP -> 400. Rate limited after 5 attempts -> 429.
